coding.headline: A skill becomes fluent, OR a reviewed build / stage-gate is cleared.
inclusion: A program that runs AND is your authorship
A chapter finished: read + notes + applied program
A deliberate-practice micro-drill round
A stage gate passed (capability test, not "feel ready")
exclusion: Watching a video / passively reading (no proof-act)
Time logged without a running artifact

typical.tiny: A from-scratch program that runs; a micro-drill round

mlai.headline: A gated Field-Foundations module (tiny), a cluster capstone (small), or whole-FF (medium).
inclusion: A module gate passed blind at ≥80
A blind cumulative cluster capstone ≥80
A genuine active-recall consolidation / daily retrieval check
exclusion: Reading the module without the blind gate
Tutor-scored gates alone (cured only by the cumulative blind capstone)

typical.tiny: A module gate / a daily retrieval check

method.headline: A qual-coding unit gate passed, OR a codebook built.
inclusion: A practice worksheet / analytic memo (genuine engagement)
A unit gate passed (capability, not reading)
A defensible top-level codebook built
exclusion: A gate the owner is unsure of (HELD, not ticked)

literature.headline: A paper three-passed / viva-defended, OR a breadth distillation engaged with.
inclusion: A 3-pass deep read + viva defense
A breadth distillation read AND discussed (your engagement)
A substantial essay read + deeply discussed
exclusion: Athena's distillation BUILD (the build itself isn't your tick)
A paper only listened to as a podcast

strength.headline: A ladder rung unlocked (avg-clean ≥ the per-set target), across 12 ladders.
inclusion: A day's training at effort, log-verified (tiny)
A rung cleared avg-clean ≥ target (small)
A new ladder unlocked (gate met)
exclusion: A rung claimed without hitting the target

body.headline: Each full-pound new low, 10-lb milestones, and keystone measurement drops.
inclusion: A calorie/protein day logged on plan (tiny)
A full-pound new low vs the ratchet (small)
A 10-lb milestone crossed (medium)
A keystone site ≥1" drop (small)
exclusion: A sub-pound move (not a full new low)
